scope: Manual inspection of real single-player decisions, events and Credit commands; screenshots and displayed wallets. These are visual observations, not automated assertion logs.

observations.normal_decision: Opened Establish a State Chartered Bank through the native Florence Content/Decisions panel.
observations.first_page: Eight candidates use the native scrollable option list; Next and Cancel are reachable with its scrollbar.
observations.overflow_page: Next shows the ninth and tenth banks, Aquisextain and Wessex, plus Previous and Cancel; sovereign treasury stays 10,000.
observations.previous_page: Previous restores Bardi and the original first-page banks without payment.
observations.cancel: Cancel closes the event; sovereign treasury remains 10,000 and the charter decision can be reopened.
observations.paid_overflow_conversion: Selected the ninth bank through its event-option button. Sovereign treasury becomes 9,500; Credit shows Aquisextain cash/assets/equity of 1,500 and no liabilities.
observations.two_choice_event: The normal event presents Merchant Finance and Overseas Investment; chose Overseas Investment. Credit displays that profile and Operating state.
observations.committed_profile_not_reopened: Clicked Choose pending specialization in Credit. No choice event opens; Overseas Investment and both wallets remain unchanged.
observations.direct_controller_deposit: Clicked Deposit 100 gold on demand. Sovereign cash becomes 9,400; selected bank cash/assets 1,600, liabilities 100, equity 1,500.
observations.direct_controller_withdrawal: Clicked Withdraw matured state deposits while paused. Sovereign cash returns to 9,500; selected bank cash/assets/equity returns to 1,500 and liabilities to zero.

limits: No release-wide language/scale or later-age transaction acceptance; those remain M10. Map loading/background rendering is not part of this finance UI inspection.
